balls.text: slower ball at a length, wide outside off. Steps out and reaches out. Comes off the cue end, trickles to Pant's right
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Slashes at that and gets an inside edge onto boot
clears long-on! This is what he's paid for! Not great lengths from Woakes this over so far. This is in the slot outside off, he shuffles into line and hammers this over the fielder
overpitched and wide outside off, chucks the hands at that and gets a thick edge fine of short third
length and wide outside off, mistimed drive on the rise to extra cover
muscled! Short and wide outside off, reaches out and goes full throttle at this cut. Sweeper slides to the left and can't get to it
slower ball at a length, wide outside off. Looks to club that over cow corner but that slides under his bat
sliced to deep point. Low full toss wide outside off, reaches for it and can't get any leverage on it. Rabada takes a few strides to his left and holds onto that

review for lbw now from DC. Slower ball at a length slanted in at off stump. Shuffles and looks to whip this behind square, caught on his back thigh. Might have shuffled outside the line....no it's umpire's call on that and also umpire's call on wickets. So he survives
oh glorious. Overpitched just outside off and he drops to one knee and goes inside-out over extra cover, lovely shape on that
low full toss wide outside off, driven straight to sweeper cover
full and just outside off, sliced out to sweeper cover
slower short ball outside off, looks to blaze that over extra off the back foot. No pace to work with, rolls out to sweeper
low full toss at leg stump, driven along the floor to long-on
spanked into the midwicket boundary! Slower ball, dropped short outside off and sitting up for him. Plants the front foot down and slaughters this
low full toss at off stump, driven firmly back down the pitch but Rabada sticks out a boot to stop
short ball wide outside off, a slower one. Gets his attempted upper cut off the under-edge to sweeper
full and just outside off, yet another flowing cover drive to sweeper's left
oh another gorgeous cover drive, but can't beat extra cover. Full and just outside off, gets nice and low and has a free flowing swing at this
slower length ball at leg stump, jabbed into the covers
slower ball at a length outside off, reaches out for an elegant slash to sweeper cover
short of a length offcutter, backs into the leg side and is forced to defend. Inside edge onto body

taken at extra cover. Woakes deceives him. Slower ball, slammed in at a length and turning away from his arc outside off. Gayle wants to slap that over midwicket and can only slice it up for the infield
carved over point! Vintage Gayle. Overpitched and wide outside off, gets down on one knee and opens the face of the bat to get that away
full and into leg stump, stabs it towards long-on
left alone. Short one at a middle stump line, arches into the leg side to let it pass
just short of third man. Full and into off stump, looks to carve it over extra cover and ends up slicing it
length and into leg stump, goes early on the attempted loft. Comes off the inside half and down to long-on. An extra run as the ball deflects off Pant when he gets down to gather it
starts with a six! Short ball up at his ribs, he steps inside the line of that and hoicks it fine, over his team's dugout

picks out deep midwicket! Overpitched, there for the whip over midwicket that Rahul has attempted. But it must have tailed in late because he can't get a full swing at this. A simple catch and that's Rahul's innings done
overpitched on off stump, patted out to mid-off
bouncer has him ducking rapidly. Nice line on it, at the helmet, and Rahul lets it go
oh expertly placed. Low full toss tailing in at off stump, stands tall and opens the face to slice this between backward point and short third
full and just outside off, driven to sweeper's right
low full toss at middle stump, punched to long-on

drilled again and clears the extra cover boundary. Overpitched outside off, nice swinging room and looks like Rahul has figured out the outside off strategy now. Waits on that and laces through the line
dropped at extra cover. Full and just outside off, drilled straight to Stoinis and that pops out as he looks to smother it. Was off balance and crouching
side-arm and slow. Dipping at a length and Gayle is happy to get forward and defend into the covers
carrom ball at a length at off stump, leans in and drives to sweeper's left to bring up his fifty. The dugout rises to applaud the captain
full and drifted into the pad, flicked to deep square
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
short and just outside off, chopped on the bounce to point
good length just outside off, leans in and jabs to point
full and wide outside off from over the wicket, Gayle steers that to sweeper cover
full and outside off, driven along the floor to long-off

sliced straight to sweeper cover! Redemption for Meriwala. Full and wide outside off, has Mayank reaching out again. This time he reaches, but he isn't position to do more than slice and hope. Gets it high in the air and Dhawan takes it with ease. A solid knock ends, Mayank's batting was crisp tonight
short of a length offcutter outside off, subdued cut to point's left
full and wide outside off, stretches his arms out to try and loft this over extra cover. Thick inside edge to deep square
low full toss at off stump, clears the front leg and drills this straight to mid-off
full and wide outside off, driven to sweeper point
short and wide outside off, can't get his bat on this attempted upper-cut
yorker outside off, chopped to sweeper's left
full and wide outside off, reaches out and slashes it to third man
yorker length at off stump, jammed into the pitch and the bowler can't stop cleanly with his hand stretched upwards

Shaw nearly takes a screamer at midwicket! That would've been a catch of the season contender if he'd got it. Length ball outside off, walks at it and drags a slog. Doesn't get height on it. Shaw takes a quick few steps to the right and then leaps one-handed. Saves that from going into the boundary, can't quite pull off the catch
low full toss outside off, driven along the ground to mid-off
full and into leg stump, 141kph. Head falls over into the off side as he misses on this flick
oh skillful batting. Rahul has range. This is a good short ball, headed for his throat. But he repsonds quickly and hooks this, hurriedly, over the backward square region
short and at the ribs, another short-arm pull, shoveled down to fine leg
helps it over fine leg this time! Short and into the hips, swivels, lifts his front foot up and a short-arm pull to lift this very very fine
disdainful! Agarwal clears the front leg and launches Rabada over the long-off boundary like it's a throwdown in practice. Superbly done, it was a length ball slanted into him

inside edge as he looks to drive on the up. Length ball outside off, throws his hands at it and is through early. Forced to dive back into his crease as he asks about stealing a single from Under the bowler's eyes
length and into leg stump, dragged aerially towards deep square
short of a length just outside off, chopped to third man's right

swiped past Pant for his fifty. A 25-ball fifty for Mayank, who has been pristine today. Short ball tucks him up though, he's late and out of position for this hook. Ends up dragging it wide of Pant down leg side
past off stump. Good length and skidding on in the corridor. Swishes inside the line to try and run it to third man
full and tailing in late as he gets forward for the drive wide of mid-off
short of a length at off stump, punched on the rise to extra cover
length and sliding into middle stump, punched on the up to extra cover
length at middle stump, punched to deep midwicket

misfield at short third from Meriwala, then he chases after it and misfields a second time! Short of a length outside off, sliced to his left and it's through. He can't flick it back in. Pant encouraging him, but it's been a bad evening on debut so far for Lukman
short of a length just outside off, chopped to point

crunched over long-off! I think he's picked the carrom ball, because he gets his hands through the line of this as it goes away from him. A solid base, on one knee, and reaches out to this length ball with the front leg out of the way
full at middle stump, driven firmly to long-on
low full toss outside off, driven to long-off's left
doesn't let it go this time. Short and outside off at 100kph. Waits on it and caresses it between point and short third
just short of point. Short skiddy ball outside off again, power on the cut again but this dips on Rabada
dropped very short outside off, nice skiddy pace at 95kph. Pulled gratefully to long-on's right
length and skidding on at middle stump, half-pull, half-sweep from Agarwal. Hoicked in deep square's direction
length outside off, another carrom ball. Stabbed to extra cover off the front foot
length at leg stump, plants the front leg out and pats this from in front of it. To deep midwicket. A carrom ball from Ashwin with an almost zig-zag run-up
short of a length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
straight to point. Short and pushed through quickly, power on that cut but straight to the fielder
full outside off, steps across and whips to long-on
full and just outside off, halfway into a sweep and gets a thick inside edge towards short fine
full and into the pads, flicked to mid-on's right but can't beat him
short of a length and tight at off stump, punched straight to point off the back foot
short of a length onto the pads and he deflects that fine off the thigh
beaten. Short of a length and lifts off from the surface as he looks to steer to third man
good length and into off stump, defended into the covers
oh elegant. Short of a length just outside off, on his toes to get on top of the bounce and then punches it past point
full on middle stump, leans in and drives to long-on
dropped short and into leg stump, waits on that and swipes it past square leg
carrom ball at a length on middle stump. Pushed back to the bowler off the back foot
length and flat at leg stump, clipped to square leg's left
good length at middle stump, punched to long-on from the crease
short of a length just outside off, punched off the back foot to cover
full and just outside off, driven to mid-off's left
beaten on the outside edge. Lands that on the seam, good length, and that jags away as Rahul pushes at it with a closed face
short of a length outside off, mistimed cut to sweeper point
short of a length and onto the pads. Stands tall and closes the face to get this glance into the backward square leg boundary
short of a length outside off, waits on that and uses his wrists to steer this cut to sweeper's left
length and just outside off, punched on the up to mid-off
short of a length and pinning him deep in the crease, on the thigh. Lbw appeal turned down as he misses on the glance
regular paced short ball, at the hips again. This time he stands tall and shovels that fine of short fine
slower short ball at the hips, waits on it and pulls to the backward square boundary
short and wide outside off, another slower ball. Cut to deep point
knuckle ball, drifted away outside off. Short of a length and watchfully pushed into the covers
short of a length and some shape away outside off, under-edge on the cut

oh this is pristine. Put him in a watch, because that is perfect timing. Full and just outside off, leans in and gets his weight into this beautifully and opens the face at the last moment to drill that through the infield
full and some shape into off stump, 136kph. Driven back at the bowler who has a frustrated shy at the stumps
pumped straight! Slower ball at a length just outside off off. Mayank clears the front leg and gets under this one before he lifts it over the bowler

misfield at cover and that rolls into the boundary. Length outside off, punched on the rise to Lalit's right at cover. He's late coming down on that and the fingertip on that isn't good enough. To add to Meriwala's misery, the siren has gone off. Agarwal has a free hit
length and just outside off, punched on the rise to mid-off

dropped at point! Half chance and Smith can't hang on. Length ball wide outside off, 136kph. Square drive is aerial. Smith is in close and times his jump well, but he can't get his hands around it. Tips it over
punched on the up through cover. Good length and across the corridor at 133kph, leans in and gets that away sweetly
short of a length and into off stump, closes the face too soon for the glance and gets a leading edge down to third man
good length and some shape away outside off, punched on the rise to extra cover
chipped into the leg side. Full and slanted in at middle and leg. Leans in with a half stride and doesn't try to keep this flick down. It's over vacant midwicket and into the boundary
full and just outside off, 131.8kph, driven back to the bowler on the bounce
short of a length and moving away from the corridor. Defended down the pitch off the back foot
good length and just outside off, nice stride forward to defend that. No swing to start
clears midwicket with the pull and that is victory sealed. Short ball at off stump, picked up early and send on its way
short outside off, walks into the line and pulls to deep square
another high full toss. There must be dew now, that's the third one. This one is called no-ball. It's also wide outside off and he manages to slice it over point
full and just outside off, driven straight to extra cover. Looks to sneak the run and succeeds. Direct hit would've been tight

Shami can't get anywhere in the vicinity of this. High full toss, thigh height. Looks to pull, ends up slicing it to short fine's left. Shami was tracking back gingerly, then took a couple of strides to his left and ended up at least five yards away from where it landed

brings out the sweep and connects! I'm not sure how many people have played conventional sweeps against Jhye before, two balls in a row. This is full outside off, square leg is in so we know why he's looking for that shot. And this time he gets it away
inside edge as he looks to sweep him first ball! Sheepish smile after that. Plants the front leg across off stump and can't get this full ball away
full and wide outside off, slashed out to sweeper cover

taken after something like four attempts at long-on! The umpire will check that but Hooda is pretty confident and Pant is walking off too. It was a slower short ball at middle stump, miscued pull to Hooda who is upright when he gets under this - it's to his right at chest height. It slips, he reacts, it hits the back of his palm and goes down. He reacts. Gets a hand on it and this time it pops to his left. He reacts. Sticks the left hand out and still can't hold it. It pops. He reacts. He manages to hold on with his right hand and smothers it gratefully
full and into the legs from around the wicket, whipped out to deep midwicket
yorker just outside off, jammed down to long-off
slower ball dropped short at a middle stump line, lines him up and pulls off the front foot over the non-striker

hammered over long-on! Rahul's gone to his No. 1 bowler and he has been let down, really. The second free hit, and this one over the boundary. Short ball at off stump, slight movement into the leg side to crease room and a firm pull to clear the fielder

there's an umpire review for a catch at backward point. Saxena seems to have taken a blinder. It's a high full toss though...and the third umpire rules that is above the waist. So it is another free hit for Stoinis. He sliced that and Saxena reacted rapidly to grab that to his left with a dive, low and lunging as that dipped on him
overpitched at middle stump, nice pace on that. Stoinis gets low and crunches it over the non-striker. One bounce and into the ad board
low full toss at middle stump, driven to long-on with the angle. The siren goes off, he has overstepped.
low full toss at off stump, punches it into the stumps at the other end. It hits the outside edge of the stumps and then hits the umpire, Reiffel. Ends up in the leg side
overpitched at leg stump, driven to deep midwicket
offcutter, short of a length outside off. Punched to sweeper's left
low full toss at middle stump, flicked to deep midwicket
slower ball at a length outside off, punched to extra cover's left on the front foot
full and just outside off, driven to long-off's left
slower short ball at middle stump, pulled to deep square's left
overpitched outside off, driven straight to mid-off

splits middle and off stump! Jhye pumps his fists. It's been an evening of some misery. But this is a decently executed delivery. Full slower one at off stump. Dhawan walks across and exposes the stumps to try and swipe another one past square leg. It's a little too full for that and he is clean bowled. Falls eight short of becoming the only batsman in the IPL apart from Stokes to have two centuries in chase
overpitched outside off, mistimed drive off the inside edge to long-on
nearly rolls onto the stumps. The ball, that is. Slower length ball at leg stump. Looks to slog behind square, it hits his thigh, gets entangled and drops into the pitch. Pant stops with the bat
full slower ball down leg side, can't connect on the flick
whipped over square leg! Overpitched and on the pads, angled in from around the wicket. Stays still and gets some flexible wristwork at this, swishing the bat furiously at it
full slower ball wide outside off, walks into the line of that to try and sweep past square leg. Can't beat that fielder
appeal for lbw but turned down. Another cutter, pitches outside leg and catches him on the pad as he looks to flick
edged and short of the keeper. Foxes Pant with an offcutter. He was looking to flick, got the leading edge that didn't carry
slower ball at a length on leg stump, pulled to fine leg
even more agony for Punjab. This is full and fired down leg side, Rahul lunges low to his right and that sneaks through
and another. Dropped short at middle stump, stands tall and pulls firmly to deep square's right. He doesn't even move to go after that
past point now! It's another short one, slower ball this time, and a very similar line to the last ball. This time he hangs inside the line and chops viciously

steps into the off side and swipes this to the fine leg boundary. Dhawan is in full control right now, doing whatever he pleases. Short and rising across the corridor, walks into the line and executes perfectly
short and rising up at the the throat, leaps to defend into the pitch
yorker just outside off, driven to mid-off
short and just outside off, backs away and steers to third man
sends him flying over long-on! Steps out and fetches this slower length ball from outside off and launches it. Mid-on was in so this was a low risk shot, and he pulled it off in style
short of a length outside off, opens the face and runs that to third man
short of a length and into the corridor, pushed through cover off the front foot

oh spoils a decent over with a well-placed pull. A carrom ball, short of a length at the stumps from over the wicket. Gets deep, gets the front leg away, pulls into the turf and bisects deep midwicket and long-on
short of a length outside off, turned through midwicket off the back foot
full at off stump, flicked to deep midwicket's left with soft hands
full and just outside off, driven down to long-off's left
full toss wide outside off, mistimed drive straight to extra cover
full at off stump, chips to long-off's right

taken at third man! Short ball at off stump, backs into the leg side early to access the off. Wants to slap this over mid-off, going by where he's pointing as he walks off. Ends up taking the axe to that ball and a very ordinary looking dismissal as he top edges to the man on the boundary
short and a little steep at the body, hurried pull to deep midwicket
too simple for Dhawan right now. Short of a length at middle and leg, nicely placed behind the line of this and quick hands as he pulls into the floor and to deep square's right
slower ball at a length outside off, shuffles and flicks to deep square
length at leg stump, shuffles and flicks to deep square
length and into the pads, looks to flick that, cops it on the thigh
low full toss at leg stump, squeezed to deep square's right and they pick up another two from him
hauled over deep square! Length ball angled into the stumps, half a step down and picks this up nicely. Uses the pace on it. Deep square leg was a few yards in from the circle and he got it over him
short ball rising into the body from around the wicket, arches into the leg side to leave it
length at the stumps, punched to long-on
length and in at middle stump, punched towards long-on and brings up his fifty. Dhawan looking good a the IPL again. Orange Cap season?
full at middle stump, miscued drive is a thick inside edge to deep square's left and a misfield allows them the second
short at middle stump, pulled to deep midwicket

slashed past short third man. This is expert maneuvering from Dhawan. Walks into the leg side in anticipation of the angle into him. Hood isn't turning them. So this turns into a short of a length ball for the cut, and he puts it away
inside edge past leg stump. Length ball outside off, looks to fetch it with a sweep and gets lucky
length and wide outside off, slashed to sweeper's left
short of a length and into the stumps, backs away and mistimes the cut
length ball delivered from well behind the crease. Dips on Smith and his attempted slow is mistimed, out to deep midwicket
dropped short at off stump, clears the front leg and pummels this past the bowler off the back foot. Well to long-on's right
short of a length outside off, cut to sweeper cover
low full toss outside off, an offbreak delivery, slugged along the floor to deep midwicket
yorker length at middle stump, jammed back to the bowler
huge lbw appeal as Dhawan misses on the sweep. Jalaj over the wicket and bowling another ball out the back of the hand. Pitched outside leg
full outside off, leans in and flicks to long-on
short and just outside off, backs away and chops to sweeper's right
length at off stump, nudged towards long-on off the back foot
short of a length outside off, under-edge on the cut
short at middle stump, pulled to deep midwicket
full on leg stump, driven to deep midwicket
good length at off stump, defended into the covers on the front foot
slower ball, short of a length and just outside off. Jabbed to point off the back foot
short of a length outside off, shuffles and clips to deep square
length at off stump, dropped into the covers on the front foot

taken at square leg! Arshdeep's slower ball works. So often he seems to be the bowler who has a Plan B for Punjab. Slower one, short of a length and across the corridor. Shaw shuffles into the off side to open up the square boundary - and fair enough, fine leg and square leg were in. But the pace off means he's through it early and gets a top edge. Gayle with some steps to the left to get under that and take it safely
short of a length and rising from a middle stump line, cops that on the thigh as he looks to glance
slower ball at a length outside off, leans in and tucks that into midwicket off the front foot
low full toss at off stump, waits on it and gently pushed it to mid-off's right. That is enough to beat the man to his right
blazed past point. There are two shots Dhawan can play in his sleep - the square drive and the square cut. This is short of a length just outside off and it is put away quickly
slower ball at a length into the stumps, steered to deep square's right off the back foot
yorker length outside off, jammed into the covers
length and in at off stump, defended into the covers
top edge over short fine. Short and up at the throat. Dhawan is half fending and half hooking at this. Eyes off the ball and cramped. But that's four

sublime! What a shot that is. Absolute disregard for the bowler. Length ball in the corridor, hardly any feet, but those hands - my word. Quickly in position with the full face offered and then a hint of a punch at that with perfect timing. Launched over the long-off boundary
short of a length just outside off, chopped to third man
short of a length at off stump, punched on the up to mid-off's left
short and into the hips, shuffles and pulls to the long leg boundary. Just used the pace on that
quickly past the off stump. Short of a length and slanted in. Shaw perhaps expects it to come in more, because he opens the face of this inside the line, trying to run it down to third man
full and into leg stump, driven straight to mid-on
another legbreak, short and at off stump. Shuffles and pulls into the vacant square leg boundary
wrist release again. I suspected he did that off the first ball of the over too, but that googly spun so much that I couldn't be sure. This one slides inwards and is punched to point
short of a length at middle, punched to long-on

is that dropped! Looks like Jalaj has bowled with his wrist here. It's a googly. Shaw hasn't picked it. Looks to cut and gets an inside edge on that, past leg stump and Rahul can't grab that, there was almost no way. Short of short fine too as it lobs up
nice shape again as Shaw goes straight. Full ball outside off, to the pitch of it and lifts it cleanly
length and turning away from off stump, punched to long-off off the back foot
oh lovely pick-up. Full and into him. Half a stride and offers the full face before getting into lovely shape and lifting that over the long-on boundary
short of a length just outside off, defended into the covers
squares him up and is taken for four anyway. Short of a length and jagging away slightly in the corridor. Angled bat at that, leading edge and third man can't get close
full and swung into the pads. Looks to flick, into it early. Cue-ends it to mid-on
short of a length in the corridor, defended to point
good length and slanted into the pads, looks to flick and is beaten
short of a length at middle stump, watchfully pushed to deep square's right
dropped short and down leg side, Dhawan waits on that and swishes that over short fine
short of a length and swung into leg stump, nudged to deep square off the hips
top edge but safely to fine leg's left. Short ball hurries him and he can't get the hook away
short of a length just outside off, punched to sweeper's left and SRK sprints and slides to his left to whip that back into play
short of a length outside off, mistimed punch off the under-edge
